headline: RBI consolidates Cyber Resilience Master Directions for non-bank Payment System Operators
effective_from: Large and Medium non-bank PSOs: on the day placed on RBI website; Small non-bank PSOs: 2028-04-01
summary_points: RBI has consolidated earlier cyber security directions into one Master Direction for authorised non-bank PSOs, issued under Sections 10(2) and 18 of the PSS Act, 2007.
It merges the 2019 cyber security controls for third party ATM Switch ASPs and the January 2020 system audit scope circular into the July 2024 Master Directions.
Covers governance, baseline security controls, digital payment security (mobile, card, PPI), system audit scope and ATM Switch ASP controls.
Existing card, PPI and mobile banking security instructions continue; this Master Direction prevails in case of discrepancy.

rows: CCIL, NPCI, NPCI Bharat Bill Pay, card networks, non-bank ATM networks, WLAOs, large PPI issuers, TReDS operators, BBPOUs, PAs
Cross-border inbound MTSS operators, medium PPI issuers
Small PPI issuers, instant money transfer operators
PPI issuer moving to a higher category
Within one year of new categorisation

who_is_affected: All authorised non-bank Payment System Operators, including PPI issuers, payment aggregators, card networks and ATM operators, and their vendors and ATM Switch ASPs.
action_required: Compliance and IT security teams should map current controls against the consolidated Master Direction, get the Board-approved policies in place and meet the applicable timeline for their PSO category.

social.linkedin:
RBI has issued a consolidated Master Direction on Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for non-bank Payment System Operators (RBI/DPSS/2026-27/475, dated November 5, 2026).

The Direction brings the earlier cyber security controls for third party ATM Switch ASPs and the system audit scope circular into a single reference document, building on the July 2024 Master Directions.

Key points:
- Covers governance, baseline security controls, digital payment security for mobile, cards and PPIs, and system audit scope.
- Board-level oversight, a Board-approved IS policy and a distinct Cyber Crisis Management Plan are required.
- Large and Medium non-bank PSOs must comply from the date the Direction is placed on the RBI website; Small PSOs from April 1, 2028.
- PSOs must also ensure adherence by unregulated ecosystem entities such as payment gateways and vendors, subject to mutual agreement.

PSO compliance and risk teams should start a gap assessment now.

Please verify the details with the official RBI source before acting.
